name: Word Count Lens
description: Drop in a draft or pull the text off the page you are reading and see it measured: words, characters with and without spaces, sentences, paragraphs, unique words, average sentence length, reading and speaking time, a Flesch reading-ease score with its grade level, the most frequent keywords and the longest sentence in the piece. Counting happens in the popup, offline.

browser_action.default_title: Word Count Lens — Count, measure, and read the shape of any text
